limitations: Purpose semantic relations (applicable_limit_selection, limit_numeric_comparison_applicability, exceedance_determination, monitoring_obligation_applicability, missing_evidence_classification) are admitted in 05_dispositions.json from pass P5; P7 compiles purpose_ir outputs from those dispositions plus world.sqlite.
documented_no_discharge_assertion has zero ACCEPT tuples in world.sqlite; Purpose C cannot emit documented_no_discharge rows until semantic adjudication admits them.
Permit PDF semantic extraction is not available; permit_stated_condition enrichment is optional and sparse (6 ACCEPT tuples).
Closed-world negation is not representable; Purpose B not-required and Purpose C conditional_not_required require affirmative evidence.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Deterministic scope filter; no unresolved judgment. Every output tuple is mechanically entailed by source DMR rows intersecting in-scope facilities and Federal FY2025 dates.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is all reported_dmr_measurement tuples for in_scope_facility with monitoring_period_end in [2024-10-01, 2025-09-30]. Completeness receipt over reported_dmr_measurement.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SQL equijoin in_scope_facility on permit_nbr; date filter on monitoring_period_end.
derivations.required_premise: reported_dmr_measurement and in_scope_facility are current in world.sqlite.
derivations.blocking_unresolved_state: None; mechanical derivation cannot block on semantic unresolved state.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Deterministic mechanical correspondence; emits zero-or-more limit candidates per measurement without selecting an applicable limit.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is fy2025_in_scope_measurement (or equivalent date/facility filter) crossed with permit_limit_schedule_row by equijoin keys and active-month overlap.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SQL equijoin on permit_nbr, perm_feature_nbr, parameter_code; monitoring_period_end within [limit_begin_date, limit_end_date]; permit_limit_active_month active for period calendar month.
derivations.required_premise: reported_dmr_measurement, permit_limit_schedule_row, and permit_limit_active_month are current.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Deterministic projection of schedule metadata into obligation candidates; does not decide FY2025 applicability.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is permit_limit_schedule_row rows for in-scope facilities with non-empty LIMIT_FREQ_OF_ANALYSIS_CODE overlapping FY2025 effective dates.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SQL filter and projection; requirement_kind standing_schedule or comment_text_present from DMR_COMMENT_TEXT presence only.
derivations.optional_enrichment: permit_stated_condition tuples may annotate conditional triggers but are not required to emit candidates.
derivations.non_blocking_unresolved_state: permit_stated_condition UNRESOLVED judgments do not block candidate generation.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Deterministic filter identifying Purpose C universe: missing numeric value or present NODI code.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is fy2025_in_scope_measurement rows where dmr_value_nbr is sentinel-empty or nodi_code is non-empty.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SQL join fy2025_in_scope_measurement to reported_dmr_measurement; filter on sentinel dmr_value_nbr or non-empty nodi_code.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose A semantic selection of at most one enforceable numeric limit per measurement; ACCEPT when uniquely established, otherwise UNRESOLVED without defaulting.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One judgment attempted per fy2025_in_scope_measurement including zero-candidate unresolved cases.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Bounded resolution over mechanical candidates using Purpose A applicability_selection policy; persisted as admitted dispositions, not re-derived in derive_purposes.py.
derivations.required_premise: measurement_limit_candidate_join and supporting mechanical relations are current; admitted disposition exists in 05_dispositions.json.
derivations.optional_enrichment: permit_limit_active_month overlap already incorporated in candidate join; additional permit semantics may be cited in rationale.
derivations.blocking_unresolved_state: Multiple tied limit candidates after bounded review; zero candidates when enforceable numeric limit expected; seasonal/effective-date ambiguity.
derivations.non_blocking_unresolved_state: None for Purpose A output rows; unresolved selection blocks downstream comparison and exceedance.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose A classification of enforceable_numeric vs report_only vs no_numeric_comparison; comparison_applicable true only for enforceable_numeric.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One judgment per fy2025_in_scope_measurement aligned with applicable_limit_selection candidate set.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Policy over LIMIT_TYPE_CODE, OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG, and limit value presence; persisted as admitted dispositions.
derivations.required_premise: applicable_limit_selection ACCEPT with selected limit_row, or explicit unresolved when selection blocked.
derivations.optional_enrichment: None required beyond selected limit schedule row metadata.
derivations.non_blocking_unresolved_state: report_only and no_numeric_comparison ACCEPT outcomes allow Purpose A rows without exceedance.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose A numeric comparison when comparison_applicable; emits exceeds, within, not_evaluable, or UNRESOLVED.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One judgment per measurement/limit pair where comparison_applicable is true.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Numeric compare after unit and statistical-base alignment check per Purpose A exceedance_threshold policy.
derivations.required_premise: limit_numeric_comparison_applicability ACCEPT with comparison_applicable true and comparable values.
derivations.blocking_unresolved_state: Unit mismatch, qualifier semantics incomplete, applicable_limit_selection UNRESOLVED, comparison_applicable false or UNRESOLVED, missing exceedance obligation for enforceable case.
derivations.non_blocking_unresolved_state: comparison_applicable false; exceedance not required for Purpose A row emission.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose B three-valued obligation logic: required, not_required, or UNRESOLVED; no inference from missing DMR rows.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One judgment per monitoring_requirement_candidate overlapping FY2025 for in-scope facilities.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Conditional activation policy over schedule, season/month flags, and stated triggers; persisted as admitted dispositions.
derivations.required_premise: monitoring_requirement_candidate and schedule metadata are current.
derivations.optional_enrichment: permit_stated_condition ACCEPT tuples for discharge-, season-, or event-conditioned requirements.
derivations.blocking_unresolved_state: OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG ambiguity; conditional trigger cannot be established; conflicting permit sources; insufficient evidence for not_required.
derivations.non_blocking_unresolved_state: permit_stated_condition UNRESOLVED for unrelated standing schedules.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose C classification among documented_no_discharge, conditional_not_required, other_documented_no_data, inadequate_evidence_for_required_monitoring, or UNRESOLVED; never infers compliance/violation from absence alone.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Evidence-gated classification policy; persisted as admitted dispositions.
derivations.optional_enrichment: documented_no_discharge_assertion ACCEPT; monitoring_obligation_applicability not_required for conditional_not_required.
derivations.blocking_unresolved_state: documented_no_discharge_assertion UNRESOLVED or absent when needed; NODI semantics ambiguous; obligation status unclear; conflicting no-discharge evidence.
derivations.non_blocking_unresolved_state: monitoring_obligation_applicability UNRESOLVED does not force a definite Purpose C class without documentary evidence.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Compile Purpose A applicable_discharge_limits JSON: rows for established applicability/comparison (and exceedance when required); unresolved list for blocked cases.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One output entry per fy2025_in_scope_measurement attempted; unresolved cases are explicit, not dropped.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Python join of world.sqlite measurement universe to 05_dispositions.json by measurement id; split rows vs unresolved per blocking_unresolved_state rules.
derivations.required_premise: fy2025_in_scope_measurement rows and admitted applicable_limit_selection and limit_numeric_comparison_applicability dispositions.
derivations.optional_enrichment: exceedance_determination dispositions and limit schedule metadata enrich rows with exceedance_outcome and grounding.
derivations.blocking_unresolved_state: limit_applicability_unresolved; numeric_comparison_classification_unresolved; exceedance_unresolved when numeric_comparison_applicable is true.
derivations.non_blocking_unresolved_state: exceedance_unresolved when numeric_comparison_applicable is false (row emitted with comparison_class only).

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Compile Purpose B monitoring_obligations JSON: rows for required/not_required ACCEPT outcomes; unresolved for UNRESOLVED applicability.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One output entry per monitoring_requirement_candidate in world.sqlite.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Python join monitoring_requirement_candidate to monitoring_obligation_applicability dispositions by requirement id.
derivations.optional_enrichment: Schedule metadata and permit_stated_condition grounding copied into row rationale fields.
derivations.non_blocking_unresolved_state: permit_stated_condition UNRESOLVED for candidates with standing_schedule required outcome.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Compile Purpose C missing_evidence_semantics JSON: rows for ACCEPT classifications; unresolved for UNRESOLVED classifications.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One output entry per no_ordinary_numeric_result_measurement tuple.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Python join no_ordinary_numeric_result_measurement to missing_evidence_classification dispositions by expectation id.
derivations.required_premise: no_ordinary_numeric_result_measurement universe and admitted missing_evidence_classification dispositions.
derivations.optional_enrichment: NODI code and documented_no_discharge_assertion context enrich unresolved rationale.
derivations.blocking_unresolved_state: missing_evidence_classification_unresolved; documented_no_discharge_assertion absent or UNRESOLVED when classification depends on it.
